issue.title: conda config clear option
issue.author: jakirkham
issue.body_markdown:
Would be great to have an option for `conda config` to `clear` a list entry of all items. For example, `conda config --clear channels` would change `condarc` like so.

```yaml
...
channels: []
...
```

comments.author: MesaJonathan
comments.body_markdown: I'd like to take a swing at this as my first open-source contribution. Does it need to be assigned to me?
